create_pipeline_subclass: create a subclass of Pipeline that implements __init__ and __call__ methods for a custom ML task
implement_pipeline_call: implement the __call__ method in a Pipeline subclass to process inputs and return model predictions
define_pipeline_task: define a Pipeline subclass with a task attribute to identify the ML task type
raise_pipeline_exception: raise a PipelineException when a pipeline operation fails or receives invalid inputs
review_pipeline_abc: review the Pipeline abstract base class to understand required methods for custom pipeline implementations
